subject: Post-call: aligning next steps & proposing three-band demo windows
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@axiomretail.com>, Tom Hansen <tom.hansen@axiomretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-call: aligning next steps & proposing three-band demo windows

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — helpful to understand Axiom's latency targets and the two main workloads (customer search embeddings + personalized recommendations). Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary goal: stable sub-200ms median generation for realtime recs; batched embedding pipeline for nightly reindexing.
- Key constraints: EU data residency for PII, APAC pilot team prefers late afternoons local time.
- Stakeholders: Elena (Product), Tom (IT / infra), Priya Shah (eng, will join technical deep dive).

Proposed next meeting: 60–75 minute technical deep dive + demo.
Because we're coordinating US / EU / APAC stakeholders, I propose a three-band rotating pattern so no region is always on evenings. Suggested rotation (pilot 4 weeks):

- Band A — US morning window (target: 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET)
- Band B — EU midday window (target: 11:00 BST / 12:00 CEST)
- Band C — APAC late-morning window (target: 10:00 SGT / 11:00 AEST)

We can run Week 1 = Band A, Week 2 = Band B, Week 3 = Band C, Week 4 = Band A (then repeat). For the pilot we'll schedule the first two sessions ~2 weeks apart to keep momentum.

Concrete asks:
1) Are you ok with the rotating-band approach above?
2) Which weekdays work best for your group (we usually see Tue/Thu perform well)?
3) Who else should be on the invite for the technical deep dive (names + emails)?

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf (sketch of milestones), timezone_matrix.csv (quick conversions).

If that pattern looks reasonable I'll work with Ben to propose specific calendar times (UTC and local conversions) and send a Calendly + provisional invite.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Post-call: aligning next steps & proposing three-band demo windows

Thanks, Irene — helpful summary. Quick answers below: 

- The rotating-band idea sounds fair and is preferable to always having one region take the odd hours.
- Preferred weekdays: Tue or Thu (we already block Mondays for planning).
- Our likely attendees for the deep dive: Priya Shah (priya.shah@axiomretail.com, engineering lead), Marco Silva (data infra, marco.silva@axiomretail.com). I'll confirm their availability this afternoon.

Major constraint: APAC participants (our Sydney/SG offices) generally can't attend after 21:30 local — late-evening calls are tough on that team. If band C lands earlier in the day for APAC (i.e., morning SGT) that's preferable.

Two candidate weeks that look good for us to pilot: week of Aug 11 or week of Aug 25. If you can propose specific Tue/Thu slots in the rotation, we'll pick one.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Park
Head of Product, Axiom Retail
elena.park@axiomretail.com

Thanks for the quick reply — below is a suggested pilot schedule with exact windows and UTC conversions. I put two candidate dates in the two-week window you mentioned (Aug 11 and Aug 25 weeks).

Pilot rotation (4-week cycle) — sample local times + UTC
- Week 1 (Band A — US morning): Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET — UTC 17:00
- Week 2 (Band B — EU midday): Thu 11:00 BST / 12:00 CEST — UTC 10:00
- Week 3 (Band C — APAC morning): Tue 10:00 SGT / 11:00 AEST — UTC 02:00
- Week 4 (Band A repeat): Thu 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET — UTC 17:00

Concrete candidate single-session options for the first pilot meeting (pick one):
- Option 1: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 — 10:00 BST (UTC 09:00) — aligns with Band B (EU midday).
- Option 2: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 — 10:00 PT (UTC 17:00) — aligns with Band A (US morning).

Notes:
- I attached timezone_matrix.csv (same file Irene included) with row-level conversions. If APAC prefers an earlier Band C (e.g., 08:00 SGT), we can swap Band C into a different weekday in the pilot.
- Pilot cadence: propose 60–75 minutes. Agenda: 1) architecture overview & infra constraints, 2) live demo of inference latency on sample workload, 3) integration/distribution plan + open Q&A.

If you confirm Option 1 or 2 today, I’ll lock the calendar and send the invite (Teams/Zoom) and add a short pre-read.

— Ben
